name: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch spinach 2 min, blend to a puree.
Saute onion, ginger, garlic; add tomato and cook soft.
Add spices, puree and paneer cubes; simmer 5 min.

name: Aloo Gobi
steps: Fry onion, add tomato and spices.
Add potato and cauliflower, cover and cook on low until tender (15-20 min).

name: Matar Paneer
steps: Make an onion-tomato masala.
Add peas and paneer, simmer 8 min.

name: Egg Bhurji
steps: Saute onion, chilli, tomato.
Add beaten eggs and scramble until set.

name: Vegetable Pulao
steps: Saute onion and vegetables with whole spices.
Add rinsed rice and 2x water; cook covered until fluffy.

name: Tomato Dal
steps: Pressure-cook lentils until soft.
Temper cumin, garlic, onion and tomato; mix into the dal.

name: Paneer Bhurji
steps: Saute onion, capsicum and tomato.
Crumble in paneer, season and cook 4 min.

name: Veg Sandwich (Toasted)
steps: Layer sliced vegetables between bread.
Toast until golden.

name: Masala French Toast
steps: Whisk egg with chopped onion, chilli and salt.
Dip bread and pan-fry both sides.

name: Raita
steps: Whisk yogurt, fold in grated cucumber and onion.
Season with salt and roasted cumin.

name: Kheer (Rice Pudding)
steps: Simmer washed rice in milk, stirring often.
Sweeten when creamy; add cardamom.

name: Banana Pancakes
steps: Mash banana, whisk with egg and a splash of milk.
Cook small pancakes on a non-stick pan.

name: Aloo Paratha
steps: Mix mashed potato, onion, chilli and spices.
Stuff into dough, roll and cook with a little oil.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Cook an onion-tomato masala with ginger and garlic.
Add boiled chickpeas, simmer 12 min.

name: Cabbage Carrot Stir-fry
steps: Saute onion, add shredded vegetables.
Stir-fry on high heat 5 min.

name: Veg Fried Rice
steps: Stir-fry vegetables on high heat.
Toss in cooked rice and soy sauce.

name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble eggs, set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables, add rice and eggs.
